card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a longer number, usually just before the last digit or digits, such as the 2 in 12.5 or the 9 in 1999. It is mostly seen in dose amounts, prices and years.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: A middle digit in a mg dose or strength, often before a decimal or a final digit.
modes.example: restart CLOZARIL treatment with a dosage of 1<<2>>.5 mg once or twice daily.

modes.label: Years and prices
modes.description: A middle digit in a year or a dollar price.

card.writes: It suppresses the digit 0 and its variants, so it nudges the model away from a zero as the next character.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, such as the 2 in 12.5 mg or the 9 in 1999.
